wizard.language.title: Choose your language
wizard.language.description: You can change the interface language later in Settings.
wizard.identity.title: Set your player code
wizard.identity.description: Used for new recordings, shared laps and your default name when first joining an estate race.
wizard.identity.label: Player code
wizard.identity.hint: Optional; up to 20 characters. You can change it later in Settings.
wizard.storage.title: Choose a data folder
wizard.storage.description: Lap data, settings, recordings and custom tracks are stored together here.
wizard.storage.fixed: The data folder was specified by a launch argument and will be used for this setup.
wizard.close.title: Choose what the close button does
wizard.close.description: This only changes the close button in the top-right corner of the main window.
wizard.close.trayDetail: Keep the HUD and telemetry running; reopen LazyForza from the tray.
wizard.close.exitDetail: Stop telemetry, the HUD and background recording, then exit.
wizard.telemetry.title: Connect FH6 telemetry
wizard.telemetry.description: Enable Data Out in the game. Setup completes automatically when LazyForza receives valid telemetry.
wizard.telemetry.instructions:
FH6 → Settings → HUD and Gameplay → Data Out
Enable Data Out, then enter the same IP and port shown here.
wizard.telemetry.waitingDetail: Start the game or enter the driving view and keep this window open.
wizard.telemetry.placeholderHint: Will be replaced with an in-game walkthrough
wizard.telemetry.invalidDetail: Enter a valid IP and port from 1–65535, excluding 5200–5300.
wizard.telemetry.endpoint: Listening on {0}:{1} · accepting valid 324-byte FH6 packets only
wizard.telemetry.completeDetail: FH6 telemetry received · {0} km/h · Starting LazyForza
wizard.telemetry.inUse: This port is already in use. Choose another port or close the other application.
